questionPrompt: Read the passage below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: The education plays a vital role in the economic development. In 2019, the Vietnam invested heavily in a higher education sector. Since then, number of universities have been doubled. Experts believe that the situation has improved since the government launch its reform policy last year.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'Economic development' is correctly used here without a preceding article in a general sense.

errors.explanation: 'Education' in a general sense does not need 'the'.
Do not use 'the' before most country names. 'Vietnam' takes no article.
Use 'the' here because the higher education sector is a specific, identified entity.
'The number of' is a fixed expression requiring the definite article.
'The number' is singular and takes 'has'. Also, 'double' is intransitive here — use active voice: 'has doubled'.
'Last year' indicates a completed past action. Use simple past: 'launched'.

title: IELTS Writing Task 2: Education — ARTICLE & TENSE
